name: hcapp_addDownDown
description: Records a new DownDown charge for one or more hashers at a run. Any authenticated user with AttendenceState >= 20 on the event (i.e. physically attended) may submit. Creates one HC.DownDowns row and one HC.DownDownHashers row per hasher in @hasherIds. Returns the new DownDown ID on success via the adHocDataId pattern. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event (run) the charge belongs to. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hasher UUID strings to charge. Each valid UUID produces one DownDownHashers row. Invalid UUIDs are silently skipped via TRY_CAST. Required — empty string triggers validation error. NOTE: the SP uses comma as delimiter, not the project-standard pipe ('|') — this is a code smell.

parameters.name: chargeText
parameters.description: Description of the charge. Required — empty or whitespace-only triggers validation error.

parameters.name: songChoice
parameters.description: Optional suggested song name (free text). Stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Optional FK to HC.Song for the suggested song. NULL if not specified.

parameters.name: chargePhotoUrl
parameters.description: Optional blob URL of an attached charge photo. Stored as NULL if blank.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned (as two rowsets at index 0 and 1) when HC6.ValidateAppAuth fails. Rowset 0 is the compact envelope { success=0, errorCode, errorType }; rowset 1 is the standard error detail. Mutually exclusive with all success rowsets.

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Returned (as two rowsets at index 0 and 1) when required parameters are missing/blank or the caller did not attend the run (AttendenceState < 20). Rowset 0: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Rowset 1: standard error detail. Mutually exclusive with success rowset.

rowsets.name: Success
rowsets.description: Returned on successful insert. Single row containing the new DownDown ID. Mutually exclusive with error rowsets.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: The newly created HC.DownDowns.id (NEWID() generated inside the SP).

rowsets.description: Returned (at index 1) alongside the compact error envelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: Inserts one row into HC.DownDownHashers per valid UUID in @hasherIds.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.issue: Comma delimiter in @hasherIds violates project standard
codeSmells.detail: @hasherIds uses comma as the list delimiter (STRING_SPLIT(@hasherIds, ',')), but the project standard is '|'. Commas can appear in some data fields and make the delimiter ambiguous. Should use '|' and STRING_SPLIT(@hasherIds, '|') for consistency with all other list parameters.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are declared as BIT NOT NULL. The project standard is SMALLINT. The SP inserts 0 (integer literal), which SQL Server implicitly converts to BIT. Dart callers must handle these as JSON booleans (true/false), not integers (1/0), because the .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean.

codeSmells.issue: Silent skip of invalid hasher UUIDs
codeSmells.detail: TRY_CAST in the INSERT ... SELECT silently discards any value in @hasherIds that is not a valid UUID. If the caller passes a malformed UUID no error is returned. This could silently produce fewer DownDownHashers rows than expected.

If @hasherIds contains only invalid UUIDs (all fail TRY_CAST), the DownDowns row is still inserted with zero DownDownHashers rows. The SP does not validate that at least one hasher was successfully inserted.
